title: Switchable tribo-electromagnetic composite generator based on magnetic-spring dynamic coupling for low-velocity flow energy harvesting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1165-1173
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01024A, Paper
Da Che, Xiao Zhang, Guanzheng Xu, Yanhui Wang, Futian Geng, Siyu Zhang, Fei Zhong, Wanqiang Zhu
A magnetic-wheel-spring hybrid generator enables self-adaptive switching between triboelectric and electromagnetic mechanisms. This innovative design provides continuous energy harvesting from ultralow to high flow velocities.
